title: Trusted Manager
body: Clients ask for you by name and your team stays. You built that one honest answer at a time.

title: Steady Hand
body: Not every call went well, but the unit runs, the numbers hold and people trust your word.

title: Hard Lessons
body: You made it, but some promises cost more than they should have. The agency is wiser for it, and so are you.

title: Manager
body: You lead a unit now. The next chapter is yours to write.
